explanationBullets: The current seed catalog does not include a dedicated generic mesh guide yet.
Use the generic router guide as the fallback, but expect more app-based wording and bridge-mode edge cases for mesh systems.
If the mesh is in bridge mode, forwarding may need to happen on another router.

notes: Uses a deliberately smaller in-test catalog (the standard sample catalog minus generic-mesh) to reach genericMeshResolution's *other* branch — unreachable against the standard 6-guide sample catalog, since it always has generic-mesh seeded. Not a second reusable catalog fixture file; built inline in the Rust test for this one case. No detected gateway IP, so the bridge-mode bullet uses the generic "another router" phrasing.
